A. Omuhinguzi Santiago naabaasa kuta omwanya gw'okwega, naashushaniisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.
B. Omuhimbo gw'emisana, Pablo areeba ekijiiko kandi yaareeba omushusho gwe naagira ati: "Reeba, Pablo!"

D. Omuhanda gw'okubungana omu rurembo, Soledad naaza aha mbuto omu mikono ye, yaagira ati: "Eziruma"

**D**

Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omubanza ari kukora omurimo gw'ekibina gw'okukora aha bu умеgyezi bw'okucungura hamwe n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi: "Kumanya eby'okukozesa n'omurimo gwabyo." B. Omu rupapura orukubairemu emiringo erikubaasa kworekwa n'obumwe aha bw'obwengye (oburungi/obukali, oburagwa/omuchungwa, obworobi/obukomeezi, omunungo murungi/omunungo mubi), taangira ebijanjaara omu muringo egirikukuratira embeera ezi.

Ku waaba nooreeba ibara ry'entege, okarikunda rundi torikukunda? Ku waaba nookora aha kikoba ky'epere, okahurira omuhindo gw'okushemererwa rundi ogw'obusaasi? Ku waaba noohumurira omucungwa, okagukunda rundi torikukunda?

Aha mirimo ei erikukurataho, niki ekira kuleetera abegi kwega aha miringo y'okwaanya ebintu ebikwatiraine, kandi nabo nibakuzya obwengye bwabo omu kucungura obuhame bw'ebirikuruga omu kunoonyereza kw'obwomeezi?

B. Omu omwe omwe, nibataana omutaano kurugiirira omu muringo gwona ogubasa kuba gubaire gusaaniire, kandi bashwijuma obwingana bw'okubaasa kukikora.
C. Omwe-omwe, nibaha ebi barikuteekateeka aha muringo ogu bateekwa kukuratira, bagira omuringo ogw'omukago, reero bagutandika kukora.
D. Omwe-omwe, nibakurata omuringo ogworekwa omwegyesa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'okumanya oburyo bw'okwahukanisa obukozesibwe omuri buri omwe.

**B**

Garukamu ekibuuzo eki ekihikire orikukurata empandiika emwe:
Omwegyesereza ari kukora aha mutwe gw'omubiri gw'omuntu omu kiraasi ey'abana, kandi nayegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza omukoro gw'omutima. A. Omutima gukomera kurabira omu mizano.
B. Omutima gw'omuntu guringana n'enkumu ye.
C. Omutima nigwija kureetera eshagama kutwara omwaka omu mubiri.

Eky'okugarukamu A nikyo kirikukora byombi: abanyeshuri nibasharamu omuringo (nibega) kandi nibasoborora ekyabareeteire kusharamu batyo (nibacungura obuhame). Ebindi tibirikukikora gye nk'ekya A.

**Ekibuuzo 4**

Garukamu ekibuuzo eki ekihikire orikukurata empandiika emwe:
Abanyeshuri baine kumanya ki kubaasa kwetegyereza emisingi y'ekicweka kya Bernoulli?

A. Okukoresa omusingi gwa Pascal
B. Okukoresa omusingi gw'okutangira amaani
C. Okukoresa omuringo gw'okugumiisiriza omu by'omwika ebirikwenda
D. Okukoresa emikago ya kinematic omu mazi agatahinduka.

**Eky'okugarukamu ekihikire: B**

**Obusobanuro:** Omusingi gwa Bernoulli n'engeri y'okworeka omusingi gw'okutanga amaani (conservation of energy) omu bintu ebirikugyenda nk'amaizi n'omwika. Nigworeka oku amaani g'omuvuduko (kinetic energy), amaani g'oburemeezi (potential energy), n'amaani g'omwitsindiko (pressure energy) birikuhindana, beitu omugasho gwabyo gwoona niguguma gumwe. N'ahabw'ekyo, okwetegyereza okutanga amaani n'ekintu kikuru kwetegyereza omusingi gwa Bernoulli.
